title: Coordinate flip
statement: For a nonnegative integer $n$, a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the coordinate flip of $x$ at $i$ is the sign vector obtained by replacing its $i$th entry with its negative and leaving all other entries unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
